violations.text: Facility does not have an individual registered to the location as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Due to facility having a High-Risk Population (Pre-K), facility is to maintain an individual that is Registered with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Licensed Food Safety Manager. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

Milk and Yogurt in prepped bags for students were observed held at 44-45 degrees Fahrenheit recently delivered from Davisville Middle School). Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC is to ensure that food items delivered to Early Learning Center by the middle school are delivered/received at 41 degrees Fahrenheit to ensure proper cold holding was maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026
